name: particle-academy/fancy-connectors
description: The runtime under every Fancy connector: modes and estates, connections, one call path, a failure taxonomy that separates "it never arrived" from "nobody can tell", deterministic fakers, webhook verification, pure versioned rendering, declared metric shapes, credential-free probes, and API-drift reporting. Owns the wire; never the gates. PHP twin of @particle-academy/fancy-connectors.

suggest.ext-curl: Needed only by the bundled CurlTransport. A host that binds its own Transport needs nothing.
suggest.ext-intl: Counts graphemes exactly. Without it Text falls back to a PCRE grapheme-cluster pattern, which agrees on everything a connector realistically sends but is not identical on rare clusters.
